articles.title: Most new regular jobs go to workers aged 60 and over, while young adults lose ground
articles.easyKo: 3분기에 늘어난 정규직의 4분의 3 가까이가 60세 이상 몫이었어요. 20대 정규직은 15분기 연속 줄었고, 30대도 줄었어요.

paragraphs.en: Most of the new regular jobs in South Korea in the third quarter went to older workers. The statistics ministry said more than 70 percent of the increase came from people aged 60 and older. Workers in their 20s and 30s, on the other hand, fell in number. The ministry released the data on Sunday.
paragraphs.ko: 3분기에 한국에서 새로 생긴 정규직 일자리 대부분은 나이 많은 노동자에게 돌아갔어요. 통계 담당 부처는 늘어난 정규직의 70% 넘게가 60세 이상에서 나왔다고 밝혔어요. 반면 20대와 30대 정규직은 수가 줄었어요. 부처는 이 자료를 일요일에 발표했어요.

paragraphs.en: From July to September, South Korea had 16.84 million regular workers. That was 167,628 more than a year earlier. The ministry compared the period with the same months a year earlier. People in their 60s and older made up less than 14 percent of all regular workers. The group aged 60 and older alone added 125,573 regular workers, which was 74.9 percent of the total rise.
paragraphs.ko: 7월부터 9월까지 한국의 정규직 노동자는 1684만 명이었어요. 1년 전보다 16만 7628명 많았어요. 부처는 이 기간을 1년 전 같은 달들과 비교했어요. 60대 이상은 전체 정규직의 14%가 안 됐어요. 60세 이상 집단 하나만 정규직이 12만 5573명 늘었고, 이는 전체 증가분의 74.9%예요.

paragraphs.en: The older group is still a small part of the whole. Even so, it supplied about three out of every four new regular jobs. Without this group, the total rise would have been only about 42,000, based on the ministry's figures.

paragraphs.en: A ministry survey in August found about 680,000 people in their 20s and 30s who were not employed and were "resting." Yonhap said the rise in older workers reflects the country's aging population. Taken together, the figures show two trends at once: an older workforce and a harder start for young job seekers.

articles.title: Samsung Lions beat the KT Wiz to win their first Korean Series title in 12 years
articles.easyKo: 삼성 라이온즈가 KT 위즈를 12대 1로 꺾고 5차전 만에 한국시리즈 우승을 차지했어요. 12년 만의 우승이고, 정규시즌 2위 팀이 우승한 것은 2018년 이후 처음이에요.

paragraphs.en: The Samsung Lions are the champions of South Korean baseball again. They beat the KT Wiz 12-1 in Game 5 of the Korean Series on Sunday. The game was played at Daegu Samsung Lions Park in Daegu. The win ended the best-of-seven series and gave the Lions their first title in 12 years.

articles.title: LG Electronics wins the top car safety rating for a vehicle communications module
articles.easyKo: LG전자의 차량용 통신 제어 장치가 업계 최초로 가장 높은 자동차 기능 안전 등급(ASIL D)을 받았어요. 이 장치는 제네시스 GV90에 들어가요.

paragraphs.en: LG Electronics said on Sunday that its vehicle communications control module won the highest car safety rating. It is the first in the industry to earn this certification for such a part. The module received Automotive Safety Integrity Level D under the ISO 26262 standard from the testing group TUV Rheinland.
paragraphs.ko: LG전자는 일요일 자사의 차량 통신 제어 모듈이 가장 높은 자동차 안전 등급을 받았다고 밝혔어요. 이런 부품으로는 업계에서 처음으로 이 인증을 받았어요. 이 모듈은 시험 인증 기관 TUV라인란드로부터 ISO 26262 기준의 자동차 안전 무결성 등급 D를 받았어요.

sents.en: It is the first in the industry to earn this certification for such a part.

paragraphs.en: ISO 26262 sets safety rules for electronic systems in cars. Its levels run from A to D, and D is the strictest. paragraphs.en: South Korean badminton star An Se-young won the Korea Open on Sunday in front of her home fans. She beat Akane Yamaguchi of Japan 2-1 in the women's singles final in Yeosu. The scores were 21-12, 15-21 and 21-16.

articles.title: Scientists say the secret to a good chat is 'pink noise'
articles.easyKo: 미국 다트머스대 연구팀은 한 주제를 충분히 이야기하다가 새 생각을 가져오는 균형이 있는 대화일수록 더 즐겁다고 밝혔어요. 이런 균형을 물리학 말로 '핑크 노이즈'라고 불러요.

paragraphs.en: Scientists say the most enjoyable conversations have a healthy dose of something called pink noise. The researchers work at Dartmouth College in the United States. In physics, pink noise sits on the edge of chaos, where you stay at a stable point but are not stuck there forever. In a chat, that means staying on a topic long enough to understand it, then moving on before it gets stale.
paragraphs.ko: 과학자들은 가장 즐거운 대화에는 핑크 노이즈라는 것이 알맞게 들어 있다고 말해요. 연구자들은 미국 다트머스대에서 일해요. 물리학에서 핑크 노이즈는 혼란의 가장자리에 있어요. 안정된 지점에 머물지만 영원히 갇히지는 않는 상태예요. 대화에서는 주제를 이해할 만큼 머물다가 지루해지기 전에 넘어가는 것을 뜻해요.

paragraphs.en: The team studied more than 1,000 conversations between strangers. People enjoyed the chats more, and felt closer, when they had more pink noise. The same was true for conversations between friends. In speed-dating chats, more pink noise predicted which pairs met for a second date.

paragraphs.en: To measure it, the scientists used an AI program called MPNet. It scored every turn of a chat on 768 different measures, such as meaning, tone and context.
